messages.subject: NaN error?
messages.body_plain:
Hi, I'm getting "In log(det(U)) : NaNs produced" when using ezANOVA. I have ez_4.2-2 and R 3.01

The command is: ezANOVA(data=tmp,dv=.(prsp),wid=.(sno),within=.(block,cs),between=.(grp))

sno has 12 levels, block has 5, cs has 2, and group has 2

The error message only appears on some analyses, any ideas on likely cause?

Thanks, Steve

messages.subject: Re: [ez4r] NaN error?
messages.body_plain:
Hi Mike, thanks for your response.

ezPrecis on the 'faulty' dataset gives

> ezPrecis(tmp[,names(tmp) %in% c('prsp','sno','block','cs','grp')])
Data frame dimensions: 120 rows, 5 columns
         type missing values min max
sno    factor       0     12   1  12
grp    factor       0      2   0   1
block  factor       0      5   0   4
cs     factor       0      2   0   1
prsp  numeric       0      7   0   1

On a 'good' dataset:
> ezPrecis(tmp[,names(tmp) %in% c('prsp','sno','block','cs','grp')])
Data frame dimensions: 120 rows, 5 columns
         type missing values min max
sno    factor       0     12   1  12
grp    factor       0      2   0   1
block  factor       0      5   0   4
cs     factor       0      2   0   1
prsp  numeric       0      9   0   1

For both datasets the ezDesign command produces identical 2x2 grids (grp x cs), each grid made up of 60 blue rectangles (sno x block), I think indicating a count of 1 in each cell.

The variance is zero in some of the cells, could this be important?

BW, Steve.
